Workflow uses manual dispatch, read-only contents/actions permissions, exact saved artifact name/run choice and baseline-bound pool/report SHA-256 plus sourceVersion, with no fresh/latest fallback.

Artifact-selected paths are resolved inside the acquisition directory and reject CR/LF before GITHUB_ENV export. Upload uses exact metadata allowlist plus RESOURCE.json, excluding corpus, scratch and captured stdout/stderr.

Guard routes only the fixed child tool, requires fresh disjoint output directories and matching monitored filesystem, redirects TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/SQLITE_TMPDIR, applies RSS/available-memory/disk/wall sampling and hard RLIMIT_AS, terminates only its owned child, uses parent-death protection and labels preserved partial state non-resumable.
